motivation.preserved_negative_result: The frozen scale-20 EVA candidate remains REJECTED and is not retuned or replaced.
motivation.question: Does caller-declared CKKS input precision alter the native EVA/SEAL decision-integrity outcome under a fixed graph, workload, compiler configuration, and validation/audit protocol?
motivation.causal_boundary: The fixed arm matrix can describe scale-associated outcome changes but cannot isolate scale from the compiler-generated schedule and modulus changes.
motivation.confirmation_boundary: This post-rejection seed-0 study is development evidence, not a confirmatory evaluation.

literature_basis.title: EVA: An Encrypted Vector Arithmetic Language and Compiler for Efficient Homomorphic Computation
literature_basis.adopted_practice: The caller supplies input scale and output range; EVA compiles the program, inserts CKKS operations, and returns encryption parameters and a signature.

literature_basis.title: HECATE: Performance-Aware Scale Optimization for Homomorphic Encryption Compiler
literature_basis.adopted_practice: Treat scale management as an explicit empirical dimension and avoid attributing performance or accuracy to graph depth alone.

candidate_matrix.selection_rule: select the smallest input scale whose Security V2 reference gate passes and whose three-key encrypted validation is SAFE
candidate_matrix.locked_audit_rule: replay only the selected compiled literal with three fresh keys and no parameter, graph, scale, or schedule change
candidate_matrix.no_safe_rule: if no arm is SAFE, report NO_SAFE and do not run locked audit

execution_protocol.sample_packing: one scalar per encrypted EVA vector of size one
execution_protocol.key_policy: one fresh native SEAL context per arm and key repeat
execution_protocol.sample_policy: encrypt and execute every row independently within each repeat
execution_protocol.arm_failure_policy: record the failed arm and continue the remaining predeclared arms

security_reference.admission_rule: record compiler Q and P bit sizes separately; execute only when both Q and QP are within the cap for LogN

falsification.security_reference_failure: skip that arm before key generation and preserve the static result
falsification.individual_arm_rejected_or_failed: preserve and continue remaining predeclared validation arms

claim_boundary.external_precision_sensitivity: eligible as development evidence after all admissible arms complete
claim_boundary.native_eva_safe_candidate_locked_audit: eligible only if the predeclared first-SAFE literal passes untouched locked audit
claim_boundary.original_scale20_candidate_status: remains REJECTED regardless of the new result
